findings.title: At the hero (above the first card) the menu retains an arbitrary previous item instead of Top Talent
findings.measured: scrolled from Signature to scrollY 0 -> active 'top-project' on one run, 'signature-2025-creator' on another; the frame shows Top Talent lit at that position
findings.cause: resolveActive() keeps the current item when no section intersects the band — a deliberate, commented choice that stops exactly-one-active dropping to zero
findings.boundedFix: when nothing is in the band, fall back to the first slug if scrollY is above the first section's top, else keep current. One condition; preserves the exactly-one-active invariant my ID-9/11 asserts.

findings.severity: pre-existing, out of this screen's ownership
findings.title: Sticky header is 80% opaque with no backdrop blur, so bright content scrolls visibly through it
findings.measured: header background rgba(16,20,23,0.8), backdrop-filter none — IDENTICAL on / and /awards-information at both 375 and 1440. Header-band non-background pixel share at 375: homepage 22%, award screen 10%.
findings.note: not introduced by this screen and worse on the homepage; this screen makes it noticeable because large gold prize text scrolls under a 245px wrapped header at 375. Follow-up ticket against the shared header, not a blocker here.
